name: v62_tax_uncertainty_clean
hypothesis: Lower unrecognized tax benefits and future tax liabilities may proxy cleaner tax/accounting quality without using EPS, close/open, FCF, EV, news, or product graph stabilizers.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fn_unrecognized_tax_benefits_a / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * future_tax_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(net_deferred_tax_assets_liabilities) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Structural repair of P0p7j6Lq after removing cashflow_op and close/open; strict corr gate vs pw6jz8ob and MPpGzqwr.

name: v62_tax_benefit_sbp_offset
hypothesis: Share-based compensation burden may be less harmful when tax benefits from share compensation offset the dilution/expense signal.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(tax_benefit_from_share_compensation_expense / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(excess_tax_benefit_sbp_financing / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Tests a tax-offset view of SBP rather than ordinary profitability or graph confirmation.

name: v62_employee_sbp_debt_cleanliness
hypothesis: A low burden from employee liabilities, stock-based compensation, and debt extinguishment noise may capture accounting cleanliness without the pv13 graph term that made earlier variants crowded.
expression: 0.38 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * employee_compensation_benefit_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.32 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(debt_extinguishment_gain_loss_value) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Near the strong RRp7mKMg/3q7llW1Z ingredients, but removes pv13_com_rk_au and hump to test whether the accounting core is independently submit-worthy.

name: v62_unrecognized_compensation_clean
hypothesis: Unrecognized compensation cost and employee benefit liabilities may identify future expense overhang before it appears in ordinary profitability.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unrecognized_compensation_cost_nonvested_awards / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * employee_compensation_benefit_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * nonvested_awards_compensation_recognition_period, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Uses high-coverage but low-alphaCount compensation-footnote fields; no EPS, profitability, price reversal, or product graph.

name: v62_operating_lease_maturity_clean
hypothesis: Lower operating lease commitments and near-term debt maturities should capture off-balance-sheet burden distinct from the active prepaid/deferred-tax alpha.
expression: 0.42 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * future_minimum_operating_lease_payments / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * current_minimum_operating_lease_payment / assets, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_maturities_repayments_next12m / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Pure lease/maturity repair of 1Y7wgq6K after removing pv13 customer graph.

name: v62_lease_liability_change
hypothesis: Falling lease commitments and lower capital lease liabilities may form a balance-sheet improvement signal with lower correlation than static lease burden.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(future_minimum_operating_lease_payments / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * capital_lease_liability_balance / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * current_minimum_operating_lease_payment / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Change-oriented lease probe; no product graph, close/open, operating income, or FCF.

name: v62_acquisition_intangible_burden
hypothesis: Lower acquisition payments, acquired intangibles, and goodwill acquisition burden may identify cleaner organic growth outside existing goodwill-level alphas.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_payments_for_acquisitions / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * acquired_finite_intangible_assets / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * period_goodwill_acquisition_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_90_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Acquisition-burden path rather than static goodwill/assets; strict corr gate vs mL8j98w9.

name: v62_intangible_forward_amortization_clean
hypothesis: Forward intangible amortization overhang may be useful when paired with acquisition burden instead of the weak v60 static intangible carrying-value blend.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * intangible_amortization_next_12m / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * annual_intangible_assets_net_carrying_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_payments_for_acquisitions / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: A more acquisition-aware version of the weak YPpM7KVR intangible probe; stop if still below Sharpe/Fitness.

name: v62_pretax_guidance_band_clean
hypothesis: Pretax guidance midpoint with a narrow guidance band may capture management confidence in earnings before tax without using EPSR, sales surprise, FCF, or EV valuation.
expression: 0.42 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ptp_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ptp_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 126), pv13_hierarchy_min10_sector_3000_sector) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ptp_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ptp_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), pv13_hierarchy_min10_sector_3000_sector) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ptp_number, 126), pv13_hierarchy_min10_sector_3000_sector) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Guidance-band variant of the 1Y7Zoj2J pretax near-miss, designed to reduce corr vs LLpZgaeL and P0pgZllw.

name: v62_total_goodwill_consensus_low
hypothesis: Low analyst-estimated total goodwill and narrow estimate dispersion may proxy lower acquisition/intangible risk without using operating profitability or close/open reversal.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totgw_mean / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totgw_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totgw_low) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totgw_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_90_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Analyst total-goodwill path; separate from static goodwill/assets ACTIVE mL8j98w9.
